mxCell.value: Create a DRAFT order. Confirming the order is a separate action.
Session and role are checked. Writes require a form token. Actor comes from server claims; the selected warehouse is validated.
A failed insert or audit leaves the local transaction uncommitted and rolls it back on disposal. Manual create has no retry token.
Before receiving: staff separately confirms the saved draft via POST /api/purchase-orders/{id}/confirm with its current RowVersion. This separate action does not add physical stock.
